_: The Add-ons page's cards, in order, and each add-on's own page. Built by build-addons.py. Each card: its title, one sentence, a visual (viz/<id>.svg), what its Copy button offers, and where a click on the card goes. `anchor` keeps the old links into the one long page (addons.html#<anchor>) landing on the card. `page` is false when the card goes somewhere that already exists.

cards.title: Share
cards.sentence: Comments reach everyone who has the page, sealed on the way.
copy: Copy command to try it here

cards.title: Voice
cards.sentence: Dictate a comment instead of typing it.

cards.title: Live
cards.sentence: See who else is on the page, and where.

cards.title: Assist
cards.sentence: An AI model on the reviewer's device points to related parts of the page.

cards.title: Agents
cards.sentence: Lets an AI agent answer comments right in the page.

cards.title: Inline
cards.sentence: Ask reviewers questions right in the page, and see the answers counted.

cards.title: Emoji
cards.sentence: Every emoji for reactions, with search and a skin tone.

cards.title: Inbox
cards.sentence: Tells people they were mentioned, even on pages they haven't opened.

cards.title: GitHub
cards.sentence: Offers to tell people on GitHub when a comment mentions them.

cards.title: Identity
cards.sentence: Reviewers keep who they are across browsers and computers.

cards.title: Updates
cards.sentence: Tells you, on your own computer, when a newer Pipeup or a security fix is out.

cards.title: Your own mailbox
cards.sentence: A small server you run for Share, so even sealed comments stay inside your organisation.

cards.title: Make your own
cards.sentence: Write an add-on for your team or company, and host it yourself.

cards.title: Save to GitHub
cards.sentence: Saves a review to a GitHub repository. No server, no token.

cards.title: Send to Git
cards.sentence: Sends a review to a service your company runs, which files it in Git.
